_note: maxElectrical (shorts + crossings + open nets) is the REAL gate: it decides whether the board works, and it is stable across runs. maxErrors is mostly fab nits and is NOISY — freerouting's result varies with wall-clock timing, and `short` has been observed at 5, 6 and 12 in consecutive runs. Treat a maxErrors trip as 'look at it', a maxElectrical trip as 'something broke'. Lowering a bar is a deliberate act: do it in the same commit that improves the router, never to make a red suite go green.

tiny._was: 1 DRC error before the residual-repair fixes; now fully clean.

residual._was: Reported 5 open nets before the count was reconciled against KiCad DRC; only 1 was ever actually open.

short._observed: DRC total seen at 5, 6 and 12 across runs; electrical steady at 1. Bar set from the worst observation.
